mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 36 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library and a waxing crescent moon. You can spot the ISS tonight at 6:32 PM as it rises in the west over Mount Horeb and travels toward the northeast near Madison, climbing about halfway up the sky. The overnight low will be 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Plan Commission meets on December 7th to discuss new projects, including the Sub-Zero expansion at Liberty Business Park. Also, please stay informed regarding several election notices for the upcoming 2026 cycles.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run today, and the Music of John Denver at the high school tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to an intersection where they located a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel and subsequently arrested him for O W I.
You can grab a scoop of the delicious Caramel Cashew flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10:30 PM tonight.
